comment: Requests one host makes of another host's peer server (peer.Peer): pages and the pages resident of a VM it migrated or forked, a fork child's claim, the cluster cache's stripes, and journal entries. Every request may lose its reply after the peer carried it out (peer/reply-lost/<request> in Peer.call), the server answers busy at random (peer/busy), stalls a connection until the peer is marked down (peer/stall), and the simulated network damages bytes (sim/network/stream-bit-flip). See scripts/check-faults.py.
